content.text:
**The free FineRx discount card** — free, no signup, not insurance.
How to use it:
1. Show the pharmacist the card, or read out the BIN, PCN and Group code.
2. Ask them to run it as a discount card, not as insurance.
3. Ask what the price is with the card and without it, and pay the lower one.
Say at the counter: “Please run this as a discount card, not as insurance: BIN 610219, PCN DRX, Group MYCARD3993.”
Accepted at participating pharmacies, including CVS, Walgreens, Walmart, Kroger, Costco. Ask the pharmacist if in doubt.
Card page: https://www.finerxfinder.com/en/drug/atorvastatin-calcium?src=mcp · printable sheet: https://www.finerxfinder.com/en/card/print?src=mcp
Atorvastatin Calcium — 30 × 10mg Tablet: $11.99 with the card at Hy-Vee, observed 2026-09-20.

Next (calls that fit this answer, arguments filled in from it):
- compare_prices(drug="atorvastatin-calcium") — What each chain was seen charging with this card.
- ask for the email address and an explicit yes, then email_savings_card() — Only if the person wants the card in their inbox. Never send without their yes.

**Free FineRx card:** BIN 610219 · PCN DRX · Group MYCARD3993
Use the free FineRx card — accepted at 34+ pharmacy chains, no signup. Save it, print it, email or text it. Savings with the card can be substantial: estimated price with the card is $11.99 (observed 2026-09-20), more on our site. Show the card at the pharmacy to get the final price.
